title: Personal Knowledge & PKM Longest Quiet Streak
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:stats
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day last(events) as prev_events
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where isnotnull(prev_day) AND prev_events>0 AND events=0 AND gap_days>=2
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_quiet_streak_days
description: Finds the longest multi-day gap with zero personal knowledge events after activity was previously present.
value: Quiet streaks often mean a broken export, a forgotten subscription, or a habit that silently died — all worth catching early.
implementation: Run daily on `obsidian:stats` after ingestion; investigate streaks that exceed your normal pause window for this domain.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest quiet streak with supporting timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the longest stretch with no personal knowledge activity at all so you can tell when a feed or habit went quiet for too long.
